body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn; the target resists its next 2 units of forced movement for that duration. The Wound remains.

surges.html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
Reduce the target's next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Golem
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Golem Full Manifestation (FM-1G). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
